climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Gewürztraminer, Riesling and Pinot Gris sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.
land: Faces the morning sun. Early light dries the dew, which cuts disease, and the grapes are spared the hottest afternoon sun.

blurb.text: An Alsace Grand Cru vineyard in Ingersheim and Katzenthal. Its wines can be made from six grapes: Riesling, Gewürztraminer, Pinot Gris and three Muscats (Muscat Blanc à Petits Grains, Muscat Rose à Petits Grains and Muscat Ottonel).
